Don't sell Reliance before you see what changed today.
Reliance jumped eleven point six percent today. Its best day in six and a half years. Before today, it was down seventeen percent this year.
Why? Profit jumped forty one percent to twenty five thousand five hundred crore, beating estimates. Revenue crossed three lakh sixty thousand crore in one quarter.
The hero? Oil and chemicals. Earnings there grew sixty eight percent, as refining margins shot up.
Jio added thirty six million users in a year, to five hundred and forty two million. And each user now pays about two hundred and nineteen rupees a month.
But here's what most people miss.
Retail, the stores you shop at, saw profit fall twenty four percent. And oil margins can turn just as fast as they rose.
So, rally or trap? Jefferies raised its earnings forecasts. But Citi says retail and new energy must deliver. Today's jump came from oil margins. For it to last, retail must recover too.
